optimizedDescription.value: Agent CLI policy: choose correct read surface and format, avoid stale/redundant calls, review semantics, preserve traceability, optimize context.

optimizedContext.value:
# Workflow Automation

## Rules
- Lifecycle status/transition/validation: prefer `--format text` for blockers/notes. Structured follow-up only: prefer `--format toon`; JSON only unavailable/asked.
- Read exact artifacts/authoring/deltas/review via `specs show`; semantic/filter/dependency/optimized context via `specs context`; normalized materialized projection/diagnostics only via `specs metadata`. Never use metadata for effective config/default working context.
- `availableOutlines` → fetch `specs outline <specPath> --artifact <artifactId>`; do not trust embedded outline trees. Follow output `Next Action` before retry.
- Agent-authored commands use plural groups (`changes`, `specs`, `archives`, `drafts`); singular aliases only.
- Skip command only when same skill execution already returned semantically equivalent, fresh decision data; never assume between invocations; ambiguity → command.
- `changes validate` is structural/state, never semantic approval. Review intent/requirements/constraints before dependent progress. Successful single delta-backed spec artifact: inspect inline diff; unavailable → `changes spec-preview <change-name> <specId> --diff --artifact <artifactId>`. Overlap/drift: merged `spec-preview`; one artifact: prefer `--artifact`.
- Maintain traceability: `changes implementation add` confirms spec↔file/symbol; tracked files are separate review surface; resolve/ignore before archive; multi-file `--file` comma list; integrity review stale links/sidecars.
- If `llmOptimizedContext`, use optimized metadata context. Delegate to optimizer agents when supported; else inline smart-caveman per `skills:agents`.

## Constraints
- None.
